activity_summary: You left last night's sheet on the board. It stops after the dagger. The two fathers are not on it. The candle is cold. You did not walk the lines, and the page has had nothing added since.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the page for later.

facets.activity: Looked at the sheet stopped after the dagger
